real_components_used: fixed recommendation labels and human-disposition contract
controlled_fixtures_used: Project 4 model output and boundary fixtures

result_status_rule.PARTIAL: one or more major assertions fail and no critical assertion fails
result_status_rule.FAIL: one or more critical assertions fail

metrics_boundary: P5-01 preserves raw execution results and completeness counts. System-level metric definitions, denominators, calculations, and interpretation are deferred to P5-02.
failure_analysis_boundary: P5-01 records failed assertions and observations without changing the suite. Root-cause and mitigation analysis are deferred to P5-03.
production_boundary: Controlled capstone prototype; nonbinding recommendations only; no autonomous external action; final human authority required.
